title: Bound robust tolerance for every allowed one-species catalytic design
statement: For any finite permitted catalytic design on0<->X with exact nominal Pois(lambda), stationarity at0 and birth-death recursion force b_n/d_(n+1)=lambda/(n+1) for TOTAL channel rates, without per-labelled-copy balance assumptions. Multiplying ALL birth coefficients by1+delta and ALL death coefficients by1-delta is an admissible independent-error assignment and forces exact stationary Pois(theta),theta=lambda(1+delta)/(1-delta). Polynomial mass-action rates and factorial tails give finite stationary jump intensity and nonexplosion by the embedded-chain holding-time argument. Absolute mean error=2lambda delta/(1-delta), so robustness necessarily requires delta<=epsilon/(2lambda+epsilon), uniformly over catalyst degree, parallel copies and nominal coefficient choices. Waiting cannot repair stationary bias. This tolerance is compatible with numerical polynomial budgets, so it is not a general robust no-go.
